Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Ingredients * 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts (I use thin-cut) * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * Asparagus, green beans, or broccoli Sauce * ¼ cup chicken broth * ¼ cup Dijon mustard * 3 tbsp honey * 2 tbsp olive oil * 4 cloves garlic, minced or pressed * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp dried thyme Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Place the chicken breasts in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Season both sides with the salt, pepper, and garlic powder. 3. In a small bowl, whisk together all of the sauce ingredients until smooth. Pour most of the sauce over the chicken, reserving about ¼ cup for later. Coat the chicken evenly. 4. Cover tightly with foil and bake:  * Thin-cut chicken breasts: 20–25 minutes  * Regular or thick chicken breasts (or thighs): 30–40 minutes 5. 10-15 min before chicken is done remove from the oven, add the vegetables, and drizzle the reserved sauce over the top. 6. Return to the oven uncovered for the 10-15 minutes remaining or until the vegetables are tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Serve with roasted potatoes, rice, or your favorite side. Enjoy! #fyp #easydinner #recipes

Quick and Easy dinner for your next busy night! One Pan Cheesy Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Rice 😮‍💨 INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes  2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning   1 tbsp minced garlic BWW Parmesan Garlic Sauce  2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup white jasmine rice, rinsed   1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese  2 oz cream cheese 4 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  If you don’t have any bacon leftover from breakfast cook your bacon, drain the grease, and chop it into small pieces. To keep this recipe even easier you could use bacon bits  Cut 1 lb of chicken into small pieces. Add butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and spread out evenly in pan. Add the chopped onion and season with salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning.  Once the chicken is almost cooked add the minced garlic and add 2-3 tbsp of Parmesan garlic sauce to the pan and stir. Add the rinsed rice to the center of the skillet and let toast for a couple of minutes. Add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir well. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover with a lid.  Let cook covered for about 15-20 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add about a cup of shredded cheese and the cream cheese. Stir well.  Top with more cheese and the crumbled bacon. Cover with the lid to let the cheese melt or pop it in the oven under the broiler for just a few minutes.  Top with dried parsley.  Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out! #easyrecipes #chicken #onepanmeal

An Easy Date Night One Pan Meal From Me to You 🍲 Cooking is a skill like anything else. The more effort and focus you give to it the easier it will be and the better you will get. If you are a beginner here’s an easy place to start.  — Ingredients: - 1lb boneless skinless chicken thighs - 2 cups of white rice - 2 cups of chicken stock  - avocado oil  - tbsp chilli crunch oil  - 1 half of a medium sized yellow onion (diced) - 4-6 cloves of minced garlic  - parsley (chopped) - juice of 1/2 a lemon - parmesan cheese - seasoning blend (salt, pepper, onion powder, mushroom powder, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper (small amount)) METHOD: - chop up everything and WASH YOUR RICE - season your chicken  - pan medium-high heat  - add avocado oil  - add chicken thighs “skin” side down - get a good sear and flip (we aren’t trying to cook them all the way right now) - turn heat down to half way between medium and low - cook chicken 1-2 more minutes and remove - add in chili crisp oil, onion and garlic  - sautee 1-2 minutes and then turn heat back up  - add your washed rice and toss together till water has evaporated (rice looks dry) - add a couple pinches of salt  - once incorporated add 2cups of chicken broth  - bring to a boil and add back in your chicken thighs - turn heat to low and cover for 12 minutes - finish with a squeeze of lemon, chopped paraely, and parmesean cheese on top  ENJOY! 🤝

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

videos.caption: Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Serve chicken over rice and spoon extra creamy sauce on top 🤍 #easydinner #dinnerinspo #easyrecipes #chickenandrice #chickenrecipes

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

Cross posting to 4 accounts has been a little crazy and ya girl needs a breather 😮‍💨 so enjoy! ☺️  ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 If comfort food had a personality, this would be it. Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

Brown sugar garlic butter baked chicken. Juicy, well seasoned, and worth every step. Make some rice because you’re going to want every drop of this sauce! Save this recipe for your next dinner 🍽️ INGREDIENTS • 2½ to 3 lbs chicken with the bone in and skin on • 1 small onion, chopped • 1 green and 1 red bell pepper, chopped • ¼ cup Haitian epis, optional • 2 tbsp Trader Joe’s hot honey mustard • 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce • 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika • 1 to 2 tsp Dano’s Cajun seasoning, or to your preference • 1 to 2 tbsp olive oil • ¼ cup chicken broth BROWN SUGAR GARLIC BUTTER • 4 tbsp melted garlic butter, I use Sam’s Club • 1 tbsp brown sugar • 1 tsp jarred minced garlic • Pinch of cayenne • ¼ tsp chicken bouillon seasoning, optional I mostly season by eye, so these measurements are a starting point. Adjust to your preference! HOW TO MAKE IT 1. Pat chicken dry, then mix with the onion, peppers, epis, mustard, Worcestershire, and seasonings. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. I marinated mine for a few hours. 2. Preheat oven to 350°F. Heat olive oil in an oven safe skillet. Remove chicken from the marinade, leaving vegetables behind. Sear skin side down for 3 to 4 minutes, then flip and sear another 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from skillet. 3. Mix the garlic butter, brown sugar, minced garlic, cayenne, and bouillon. 4. Add the vegetables and remaining marinade to the skillet. Sauté for 2 to 3 minutes. 5. Place chicken on top, skin side up. Spoon over the butter mixture and add the broth. 6. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil, baste with the pan juices, and bake uncovered for about 10 more minutes, or until every piece reaches 165°F in the thickest part, away from the bone. 7. Rest for 5 minutes and serve with rice and green beans. Don’t forget that sauce! Epis is a Haitian seasoning base with ingredients like peppers, garlic, herbs, and spices. I love using it, but you can make this without it! #BakedChicken #ChickenRecipe #DinnerIdeas #GarlicButterChicken #HomeCooking

ad Discover the joy of a table for one… …from the comfort of your own kitchen😍There’s nothing more comforting than a cosy bowl of ramen and it’s the perfect thing to make for yourself when you want something that feels kinda fancy but really takes minimal effort! For this sticky sesame chicken ramen I’m using @itsu sesame chicken broth for noodles and their restaurant-quality ramen noodles, topped with sticky pan-fried sesame chicken, broccoli, spring onions, fresh herbs and chilli oil, it’s the perfect dinner for one🍜 For one bowl, you need: 1 Chicken Thigh  2 Tsp Light Soy Sauce 1 Tsp Dark Soy Sauce 1 Tsp Oyster Sauce 1 Tsp Rice Wine Vinegar 2 Tsp Maple Syrup 1 Tsp Sesame Oil 250ml itsu Sesame Chicken Broth 1 Pack of itsu Ramen Noodles 1 Portion of Tenderstem Broccoli Fresh Coriander, Spring Onions, Sesame Seeds & itsu Crispy Chilli Oil (to top) 1.⁠ ⁠Pan fry your chicken thigh in a little sesame oil, skin side down, over a medium-high heat. Mix the light soy, dark soy, oyster sauce, vinegar, maple and sesame oil together. Once the chicken skin is crispy, flip the chicken then turn the heat down and add the sauce. Cook until the chicken is done and the sauce is reduced. 2.⁠ ⁠Heat the sesame chicken broth in a pan. Boil the noodles and the tenderstem broccoli together for 4-5 minutes in a separate pan.  3.⁠ ⁠Assemble the bowl by adding the noodles, chicken and broccoli then pouring over the broth. Top with fresh coriander, sliced spring onions, sesame seeds and chilli oil. #dinnerforone #tableforone #chickenramen #ramen #easyramen
